corpus: all pinned ESCI product metadata, one document per locale-product key
statistics: full-catalog statistics for each locale-specific title field
normalization: Unicode NFKC before the same locale analyzer for documents and queries
query: Lucene QueryBuilder.createBooleanQuery with SHOULD terms and default graph handling; no query-string syntax
candidate_scope: all and only judged candidates for each prepared validation query
tie_break: ascending product_id after descending BM25 score
metric: NDCG@10 with linear ESCI gains and log2(rank+1) discount; zero ideal DCG gives 0
secondary_aggregate: equal-weight mean of the three locale means

confidence.method: paired percentile bootstrap of locale-normalized query groups

hypothesis: title BM25 improves validation NDCG@10 over the deterministic product-ID-order reference
tuning: none; one predeclared title-only configuration; no official test scoring
